claims.text: Resort guests have access to The Ritz-Carlton Beach Club, three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.

findings.quote: Guests of the Sarasota resort have access to our exclusive Beach Club located three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.

claims.text: A complimentary shuttle runs hourly between the resort and the Beach Club, starting daily at 9 a.m.

findings.quote: A complimentary shuttle runs hourly between the resort and the club beginning daily at 9 a.m.

claims.text: The Beach Club has a zero-entry outdoor pool that is heated year-round.

findings.quote: Spend a day under the sun in our zero-entry outdoor pool, heated year-round for guest comfort.

claims.text: Jack Dusty is a waterfront seafood restaurant with local ingredients, craft microbrews and cocktails, and downtown marina views.

findings.quote: this signature waterfront seafood restaurant in Sarasota showcases fresh local ingredients, craft microbrews and cocktails, with downtown marina views.

claims.text: Rufa serves cocktails and shareables with sunset views of Sarasota Bay.

findings.quote: Rufa elevates the senses with imaginative cocktails, shareables and breathtaking sunset views of Sarasota Bay.

claims.text: The Lido Key Tiki Bar is an open-air tiki hut next to the Beach Club and a Lido Beach public access point.

findings.quote: This authentic, open-air tiki hut offers beachside bites, refreshing cocktails and a tropical atmosphere. The Tiki Bar is located adjacent to The Ritz-Carlton Beach Club and a Lido Beach public access point.

claims.text: Jack Dusty received a 2025 OpenTable Diners' Choice Award.

findings.quote: 2025 OpenTable Diners' Choice Award - Jack Dusty

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites have private balconies and marble-trimmed bathrooms.

findings.quote: Drink in sweeping Florida views from your private balcony, retreat to the marble-trimmed bathroom for a spa-like escape
findings.note: Applies to each suite and guest room.

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite has expansive windows and private balconies with panoramic views of the Bay and marina.

findings.quote: This hotel suite's expansive windows and private balconies offer panoramic views of the Bay and marina.

claims.text: The spa's wellness facilities include a jacuzzi, steam and dry saunas, and a waterfront relaxation terrace.

findings.quote: The wellness facilities here include a jacuzzi, state-of-the-art gym, steam and dry saunas, a waterfront relaxation terrace, and 17 treatment rooms for luxurious spa treatments.

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club course was designed by Tom Fazio and is 13 miles from the resort, at Lakewood Ranch.

findings.quote: Designed by Tom Fazio, this exclusive par-72 golf course resides 13 miles away from the resort in Lakewood Ranch.

claims.text: Ridley's Porch, the Beach Club restaurant, is named for the rare Kemp's ridley sea turtles that frequent the shore.

findings.quote: Named for the rare Kemp’s ridley sea turtles that frequent our shores
findings.note: Ridley's Porch on Beach Club page.

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club course was designed by Tom Fazio.

findings.quote: The 18-hole, Tom Fazio-designed golf course at The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club features renowned play as well as lessons and a full-service pro shop.

claims.text: Resort guests have access to the Beach Club on the white sands of Lido Key.

findings.quote: Guests of the Sarasota resort have access to our exclusive Beach Club located three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.

claims.text: The spa's signature treatment combines a full-body massage, exfoliation and a mineral-rich seaweed soak.

findings.quote: Calm your senses with the Spa’s signature treatment, featuring a full-body massage, exfoliation and mineral-rich seaweed soak

claims.text: The resort is in downtown Sarasota, and the Beach Club is a separate site three miles away.

Located just three miles from the main hotel on the beautiful white sand beaches of Lido Key

findings.quote: Designed by Tom Fazio, this exclusive par-72 golf course resides 13 miles away from the resort in Lakewood Ranch.

claims.text: Club Level access is a paid premium and is not included in general room bookings.
